scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
It's been a long
time, my friend. With
your help, my wife has
gotten much better.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
好久不見，我的朋友。
多虧了你的幫助，
我妻子的身體
已經好多了。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Once again, I want to
thank you for what you've
done for me. Please drop
by anytime whenever you
come visit my town.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
再次感謝
你為我所做的一切。
如果你來我的城鎮，
請隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Oh, welcome.
So did you bring
everything that
I've asked you?
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
哦，歡迎。
那麼，你帶齊了
我讓你準備的東西嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 不，還沒準備好。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Let me check the items
that you brought before
I give you an Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
讓我檢查一下
你帶來的物品，
然後再給你
神之金屬。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Good, you brought
everything! Now let me
give you this Oridecon.
I'm sorry that I can't offer
you much more than this.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
很好，你帶齊了！
現在給你這塊神之金屬。
抱歉，我沒法
給你更多了。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Alright then,
adventurer. I hope
you travel in safety.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
那麼，冒險者。
祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Hmmm, it seems you're
carrying too many things
with you. Shouldn't you
store some of your items
in Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
嗯...？
你身上帶的東西
好像太多了。
難道你不該先把
一些物品存進卡普拉倉庫嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Hm...?
You're missing some
things. Let me tell you
what you need to bring
once again so that I can
give you 1 Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
嗯...？
你少帶了一些東西。
讓我再告訴你一次
你需要帶什麼，
這樣我才能給你
1塊神之金屬。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
40 Large Jellopy,
10 Emveretarcon,
3 Coal and
10 Zargon.
Please don't
forget this.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
40個巨大傑勒比結晶，
10個強化武器金屬-級數二，
3塊煤炭和
10個剎勒空結晶。
請不要忘記這些。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Oh, alright.
Let me remind
you of what you
need to trade for
1 Oridecon in
case you've forgotten.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
哦，好吧。
讓我提醒你一下
交換1塊神之金屬
所需的物品，
以防你忘記了。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
40 Large Jellopy,
10 Emveretarcon,
3 Coal and
10 Zargon.
Come back
whenever you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
40個巨大傑勒比結晶，
10個強化武器金屬-級數二，
3塊煤炭和
10個剎勒空結晶。
準備好了隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Recently, we've had some
tunnel cave-ins which resulted
in miner casualties. We're having
a harder time working in the
mines now that we're even
lower on manpower.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
最近，我們發生了一些
隧道坍塌事故，
導致礦工傷亡。
現在人手更少，
在礦裡工作更難了。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
What's really suspicious
is that it seems something
has been making the tunnels
collapse on purpose. Some of
us believe it's because we've
angered the master of the cave.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
真正可疑的是，
似乎有什麼東西
故意讓隧道坍塌。
我們中的一些人認為，
這是因為我們
惹怒了洞穴的主人。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
The tunnel accident
is still fresh in my mind.
It seems that there are
more ^FF0000Cave Master^000000 sightings
when the tunnels started
to inexplicably collapse.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
隧道事故
還歷歷在目。
似乎當隧道
開始莫名其妙地坍塌時，
^FF0000洞穴主人^000000
出現的次數也更多了。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
I was off duty when
the accident happened.
Still, I hear the only survivor
went crazy and disappeared
somewhere. The poor bastard...
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
事故發生時
我正好下班。
但我聽說唯一的倖存者
瘋了，然後
不知去向。可憐的傢伙...

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
You're...
You're just as
bad off as I am!
I feel so sorry for you
that I'd give you some
zeny if I could spare it...
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
你...
你的處境
和我一樣糟糕！
我很同情你，
如果我能勻出一些
Zeny，真想給你...

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Hmm...?
I'm sorry, but
I don't think I have
the luxury of chatting
at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
嗯...？
抱歉，但我現在
恐怕沒有
閒聊的餘裕。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
My wife was seriously
injured when she was
working with me in the
mine when it collapsed.
It's agonizing, wondering
if she'll be okay or not.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
我妻子和我一起在
礦裡工作時，
隧道坍塌了，
她受了重傷。
不知道她能不能好起來，
這讓我很痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Luckily no one
was killed, but my
wife is... ^333333*S-Sob*^000000
I'm sorry, but I need
to be alone right now...
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
幸好沒有人
喪命，但我妻子...
^333333*抽泣*^000000
抱歉，我現在
需要一個人靜靜...

scripts.text: I can help you.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫你。

scripts.text: Okay...
scripts.translation: 好的...

scripts.text: An accident?
scripts.translation: 是意外嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Are you serious?!
Thank you, thank you so much!
A-as you can see, I'm not doing
so well financially. But I've got to get my wife to a hospital.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
你是認真的嗎？！
太感謝你了，真的非常感謝！
如你所見，我現在的經濟狀況很糟糕。但我必須把我妻子送到醫院去。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
And since I've got to
take of her myself,
I haven't been able to work.
I don't know what I should do.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
因為我要親自照顧她，
所以我一直沒能工作。
我不知道該怎麼辦才好。

scripts.text: Then how can I help?
scripts.translation: 那我該怎麼幫你？

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Well, to be frank,
I'm in dire need of zeny.
It costs 1,000 zeny to cover
her medical expenses and
food for just one day.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
說實話，
我急需Zeny。
僅僅一天的醫療費和伙食費
就需要1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Help Him.
scripts.translation: 幫助他

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Hmmm, it seems you're
carrying too many things
with you. Shouldn't you
store some of your items
in Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
嗯...？
你身上帶的東西
好像太多了。
難道你不該先把
一些物品存進卡普拉倉庫嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Oh...!
Thank you, you
can't imagine how
grateful I am! I never
believed that I'd meet
someone as kind as you.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
哦...！
謝謝你，你無法想像
我有多感激！我從未想過
能遇到像你這樣善良的人。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Other adventurers have
also been helping me, so
with all of your help, my wife
has been getting better.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
其他冒險者
也在幫助我，
多虧了大家的幫助，
我妻子的病情正在好轉。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
I would like to give
you a small present
as a token of my gratitute.
If you would, please take this.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
我想送你一份小禮物
以表達我的感激之情。
如果你不介意的話，請收下這個。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
I've been keeping these
kinds of metals since I was
sure they'd be more useful
to someone other than me.
Hopefully, you'll find this ore
useful in one way or another.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
我一直留著這些金屬，
因為我覺得它們對別人
可能比對我更有用。
希望這些礦石能在某方面對你有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
If I were still
working, I'd try my
best to pay you back.
But my current situation
doesn't really allow it...
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
如果我還在工作，
我會盡力報答你的。
但我目前的情況
實在不允許...

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Still, I'd be happy
to trade you 1 Oridecon
if you can bring me some
items. How does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
不過，如果你能給我一些物品，
我很樂意用1個神之金屬與你交換。
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Would you bring me
40 Large Jellopy,
10 Emveretarcon,
3 Coal and
10 Zargon?
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
你能給我帶來
40個巨大傑勒比結晶，
10個強化武器金屬-級數二，
3個煤炭和
10個剎勒空結晶嗎？

scripts.text: Sure~!
scripts.translation: 沒問題~！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Great...!
Now I need to go
take care of my wife.
Come back when you
gather everything I've
asked you to bring.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
太好了...！
現在我要去照顧我妻子了。
等你集齊我讓你帶的東西后，
再回來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
I see.
Well, I understand
that adventurers don't
stay in one place for
very long. Once again,
thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
我明白了。
我知道冒險者
不會在一個地方停留太久。
再次感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
But please take
this small gift
as a token of
my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
但請收下
這份小禮物，
以表達我的感激之情。

If I were still
working, I'd try my

以表達我的感激之情。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
I understand.
I'm sorry that I've
asked so much of you.
But please understand
that I'm desperate...
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
我理解。
抱歉，我向你提出了
這麼多要求。
但請理解，
我是走投無路了...

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
You're...
You're heartless!
^666666*Sob...*^000000
Can't you see that I'm
poor and need help?!
scripts.translation:
[卡維塔爾]
你...
你真沒良心！
^666666*抽泣*^000000
你難道看不出我
很窮，需要幫助嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh hello hello~
It's been a long
time since we've talked,
you cutie adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
哎呀，你好呀~
好久沒聊了，
可愛的小冒險者~

scripts.text: So... You're a chef.
scripts.translation: 所以...你是廚師。

scripts.text: Yes, I tried my best.
scripts.translation: 是的，我盡力了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
You're a chef.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以...
你是廚師。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
That's right, it's
what I do for business.
Now, as for what I do for
^EEA9B8pleasure^000000, well, please don't
hesitate to ask, sugar honey~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
沒錯，這是我的工作。
至於我為了^EEA9B8快樂^000000做的事嘛，
儘管開口就好，親愛的~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Only continuous effort will lead you to success. I guess that means you've learned your lesson, sugar honey~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
只有持續的努力才能帶來成功。看來你已經吸取教訓了，親愛的~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh, I was going to give
you a little something,
but you've carrying too
many things. Why don't
you put some of it away
in your Kafra Storage?
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
哦，我本來想送你點東西，
但你身上帶的東西太多了。
為什麼不把一些放進卡普拉倉庫呢？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
I had these lying
around, so why don't
you take them, sugar
honey? They're not very
pricey, but they're useful
in doing some smithing.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
這些是我隨手放著的，
拿去用吧，親愛的？
雖然不值什麼錢，
但在鍛造時很有用。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Alright then~
Hope you enjoy
your Mini Furances
...Ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
那麼~
希望你能享受

呵呵~

你的迷你佛朗西
[烏維]

[烏維]

scripts.translation:

been absolutely wrooooong.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]

那就完全錯錯錯錯啦。

歡迎來到艾音布羅克，小可愛~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
...
......

[Uwe]

goes wrong! It's those people
who just embarrass themselves~
scripts.translation:

不不不不不~
東西做壞了，人們總是怪材料！
就是那些人讓自己出醜啦~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Now, if you have the pride to only use the very best ingredients you can find, then that's fine. But the quality of whatever you make can't depend on the ingredients alone.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
當然，如果你有自信只用你能找到的最好材料，那沒問題。但製作出的品質不能只取決於材料。

someone just gave me some
Steel. Why don't you have 2 of
them as my little way of saying, ''Welcome to Einbroch, cutie~!''
scripts.translation:

說到材料，有人剛給了我一些鋼鐵。
不如拿2個吧，就當是我表示“歡迎來到艾音布羅克，小可愛~”的心意。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, skill alone isn't
enough to make something
great. You also need to put in
the effort. You can't complain
about not having enough skill
when you slack off, right?
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
嗯，光有技術還不夠做出偉大的作品。
你還需要付出努力。偷懶的時候，
不能抱怨自己技術不夠，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
You always need to invest
time and effort to make your
crafts stand out. Now, if you
meet someone whose skill
makes yours seem pathetic, driving you to improve yourself...
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
你總是需要投入時間和精力，
才能讓作品脫穎而出。現在，如果你遇到一個技術比你強得多的人，
讓你想要提升自己...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Then by all means,
feel free to follow
your drive and improve
your skills! Just don't
fall back on your lack
of skills as any excuse.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
那就儘管追隨你的動力，
提升你的技術吧！只是別拿技術不足
當任何藉口。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oooh, I just received

Welcome to Einbroch, cutie~
scripts.translation:

哦哦，我今天剛收到一些艾姆維塔糖，

一個擁有所有工具的孩子，
也拼不出一把劍。

Tools are helpful, but
master craftsmen never blame

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch was originally
built to support Einbech's
mining efforts. Because it's
small and crowded with people,
there's no room to build the ore refining factories over there.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
艾音布羅克最初是為了支援
艾音貝赫的採礦工作而建立的。
因為那裡地方狹小且人口密集，
沒有空間在那裡建造礦石精煉廠。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Since Einbroch used to be
an empty lot, it was perfect
for building factories. That's
what my grandfather told me a
long time ago. Anyway, Einbroch quickly grew into a major city.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
既然艾音布羅克以前是一片空地，
非常適合建工廠。這是我祖父很久以前告訴我的。
總之，艾音布羅克很快發展成了一個主要城市。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Now people think that this
city was never planned to be
just an extension of Einbech.
See that rampart over there?
It doesn't connect to Einbech at all! No protection for them...
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
現在人們認為這座城市
從未被規劃為僅僅是艾音貝赫的延伸。
看到那邊的城牆了嗎？
它根本沒有與艾音貝赫相連！對他們沒有任何保護...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's like the government
lost all interest in Einbech.
Even the miners there have
been moving here to work in 
the factories. But more people hasn't made this city more lively.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
這就像政府完全失去了
對艾音貝赫的興趣一樣。
甚至那裡的礦工也搬到這裡
在工廠工作。但更多的人並沒有讓這座城市變得更熱鬧。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch may look modern
and exciting now, but soon
you'll see that there's no sign
of warmth or life. So... Just don't live here in your old age.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
艾音布羅克現在看起來可能很現代、很刺激，
但很快你就會發現那裡沒有溫暖和生機的跡象。
所以... 老了以後千萬別住在這裡。

scripts.text: Then why are you here?
scripts.translation: 那你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text: But I like the city life~
scripts.translation: 但我喜歡城市生活~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, sugar honey,
I've been waiting for
someone. But... It looks
like that person won't be
coming back anyway.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
哎呀，親愛的，
我一直在等一個人。但是... 看起來那個人
反正也不會再回來了。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oooh, but let's not talk
about that. Next time you
drop by, we'll talk about
something more fun, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
噢噢，但我們別談那個了。
下次你來的時候，我們聊點更有趣的事，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Big cities can be nice,
but you never get to enjoy
the sensation of stepping
barefoot through the grass,
or the magnificent sight of
the shining stars at night.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
大城市雖然不錯，
但你永遠無法享受赤腳踩在草地上的感覺，
或者夜晚璀璨星空的壯麗景色。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
And the people who live
in the cities can be so
uptight! I've known more
than a few who look down
on people from smaller towns.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
而且住在城市裡的人
往往很拘謹！我認識不少
瞧不起小城鎮居民的人。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's sad to see some
people will always be
that ignorant. I... I just
can't believe those people
can be sooo close minded!
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
看到有些人總是那麼無知，真讓人難過。
我... 我簡直不敢相信那些人
可以那麼狹隘！

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh...!

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch was originally
built to support Einbech's
mining efforts. Because it's
small and crowded with people,
there's no room to build the ore refining factories over there.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
艾音布羅克最初是為了支援
艾音貝赫的採礦工作而建立的。
因為那裡地方狹小且人口密集，
沒有空間在那裡建造礦石精煉廠。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Since Einbroch used to be
an empty lot, it was perfect
for building factories. That's
what my grandfather told me a
long time ago. Anyway, Einbroch quickly grew into a major city.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
既然艾音布羅克以前是一片空地，
非常適合建工廠。這是我祖父很久以前告訴我的。
總之，艾音布羅克很快發展成了一個主要城市。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Now people think that this
city was never planned to be
just an extension of Einbech.
See that rampart over there?
It doesn't connect to Einbech at all! No protection for them...
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
現在人們認為這座城市
從未被規劃為僅僅是艾音貝赫的延伸。
看到那邊的城牆了嗎？
它根本沒有與艾音貝赫相連！對他們沒有任何保護...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's like the government
lost all interest in Einbech.
Even the miners there have
been moving here to work in 
the factories. But more people hasn't made this city more lively.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
這就像政府完全失去了
對艾音貝赫的興趣一樣。
甚至那裡的礦工也搬到這裡
在工廠工作。但更多的人並沒有讓這座城市變得更熱鬧。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch may look modern
and exciting now, but soon
you'll see that there's no sign
of warmth or life. So... Just don't live here in your old age.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
艾音布羅克現在看起來可能很現代、很刺激，
但很快你就會發現那裡沒有溫暖和生機的跡象。
所以... 老了以後千萬別住在這裡。

scripts.text: Then why are you here?
scripts.translation: 那你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text: But I like the city life~
scripts.translation: 但我喜歡城市生活~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]

I've been waiting for someone. But... It looks like that person won't be coming back anyway.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
哎呀，親愛的，
我一直在等一個人。但是... 看起來那個人
反正也不會再回來了。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oooh, but let's not talk about that. Next time you drop by, we'll talk about something more fun, 'kay? Buhbye~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
哎呀，我們別聊這個了。下次你來的時候，我們聊點更有趣的話題，好不好？拜拜~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, big cities are nice, but you never get to enjoy the sensation of stepping barefoot through the grass, or the clear sight of the stars at night.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
大城市確實不錯，但你永遠無法享受赤腳踩在草地上的感覺，或者在夜晚仰望清澈星空的愜意。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
And the people who live in cities can be so uptight! I've known more than a few who look down on people who live in smaller towns.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
而且住在城裡的人總是那麼拘謹！我認識不少瞧不起住在小城鎮的人。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's sad to see some people will always be that ignorant. I... I just can't believe people can be sooo close minded!
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
看到有些人總是如此無知，真讓人難過。我...我簡直不敢相信人們可以這麼狹隘！

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh...!
I'm sorry, I guess I went a little overboard. ^666666*Titter*^000000 Next time you drop by, we'll talk about something more fun, 'kay? Buhbye~
scripts.translation:

抱歉，我好像有點說得太多了。^666666*咯咯笑*^000000 下次你來的時候，我們聊點更有趣的話題，好不好？拜拜~

made out of ^0000FFJubilee^000000,
a crystallization dropped
from mineral monsters.

to make weapons, but

cooking utensils! *Tee hee~*

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

would you please give me
30 ^0000FFJubilee^000000 and 4 ^0000FFLarge Jellopy^000000.

scripts.text:

built to support Einbech's
mining efforts. Because it's
small and crowded with people,
there's no room to build the ore refining factories over there.

艾音貝赫的採礦工作而建立的。
因為那裡地方狹小且人口密集，
沒有空間在那裡建造礦石精煉廠。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]

an empty lot, it was perfect
for building factories. That's
what my grandfather told me a
long time ago. Anyway, Einbroch quickly grew into a major city.

總之，艾音布羅克很快發展成了一個主要城市。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]

city was never planned to be
just an extension of Einbech.

It doesn't connect to Einbech at all! No protection for them...
scripts.translation:

從未被規劃為僅僅是艾音貝赫的延伸。

它根本沒有與艾音貝赫相連！對他們沒有任何保護...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]

lost all interest in Einbech.
Even the miners there have
been moving here to work in 
the factories. But more people hasn't made this city more lively.
scripts.translation:

這就像政府完全失去了
對艾音貝赫的興趣一樣。
甚至那裡的礦工也搬到這裡
在工廠工作。但更多的人並沒有讓這座城市變得更熱鬧。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]

and exciting now, but soon
you'll see that there's no sign
of warmth or life. So... Just don't live here in your old age.
scripts.translation:

但很快你就會發現那裡沒有溫暖和生機的跡象。
所以... 老了以後千萬別住在這裡。

scripts.text: I won't. Thanks for the advice.

themselves can't make
just anybody a master.

如果有更好的工具，

In the end, the best
tools are the ones you're
most comfortable with using.

a little novice chef~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
說到底，最好的工具還是你最順手的那一把。
事實上，我至今還在用剛入行時那把舊刀呢~

a fun talk. Come
back and visit, 'kay?

the next time~

...呵呵~

scripts.translation:

保重~

呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Hello, cutie~
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
你好呀，寶貝~
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Talk about Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 聊聊艾音布羅克。

scripts.text: Ask him to forge a Weapon.
scripts.translation: 請他鍛造武器。

scripts.text: Master, I want to learn cooking.
scripts.translation: 師父，我想學烹飪。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch was originally
built to support Einbech's
mining efforts. Because it's
small and crowded with people,
there's no room to build the ore refining factories over there.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
艾音布羅克最初是為了支援
艾音貝赫的採礦工作而建立的。
因為那裡地方狹小且人口密集，
沒有空間在那裡建造礦石精煉廠。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Since Einbroch used to be
an empty lot, it was perfect
for building factories. That's
what my grandfather told me a
long time ago. Anyway, Einbroch quickly grew into a major city.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
既然艾音布羅克以前是一片空地，
非常適合建工廠。這是我祖父很久以前告訴我的。
總之，艾音布羅克很快發展成了一個主要城市。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Now people think that this
city was never planned to be
just an extension of Einbech.
See that rampart over there?
It doesn't connect to Einbech at all! No protection for them...
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
現在人們認為這座城市
從未被規劃為僅僅是艾音貝赫的延伸。
看到那邊的城牆了嗎？
它根本沒有與艾音貝赫相連！對他們沒有任何保護...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's like the government
lost all interest in Einbech.
Even the miners there have
been moving here to work in 
the factories. But more people hasn't made this city more lively.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
這就像政府完全失去了
對艾音貝赫的興趣一樣。
甚至那裡的礦工也搬到這裡
在工廠工作。但更多的人並沒有讓這座城市變得更熱鬧。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch may look modern
and exciting now, but soon
you'll see that there's no sign
of warmth or life. So... Just don't live here in your old age.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
艾音布羅克現在看起來可能很現代、很刺激，
但很快你就會發現那裡沒有溫暖和生機的跡象。
所以... 老了以後千萬別住在這裡。

scripts.text: Then why are you here?
scripts.translation: 那你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text: I won't. Thanks for the advice.
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝你的建議。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, I have some
precious memories of
this place. Once, there was
a man who lived here who
was just like a father to me.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
嗯，我對這個地方有著珍貴的回憶。
曾經，這裡住著一位老人，他對我來說就像父親一樣。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh, but I'm sure that
you don't want to hear
about that. Next time you
drop by, we'll talk about
something more fun, 'kay?
Buhbye for now, cutie~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
噢，不過我猜你不想聽這些。
下次再來時，我們再聊點更有趣的話題，好嗎？
那先拜拜了，親愛的~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh, that is such
a good decision,
sugar honey! Oh, you
cutie adventurers are
so precious, so lovable.
^333333*Tee hee hee~*^000000
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
噢，真是個好決定，甜心！
噢，你們這些可愛的冒險者真是太珍貴、太討人喜歡了。
^333333*嘻嘻嘻~*^000000

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, that was
a fun talk. Come
back and visit, 'kay?
I'll miss you until
the next time~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
嗯，聊得很開心。
記得再來玩哦。
在那之前我會想你的~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well...
I actually just
do smithing work
to create my own
cooking tools.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
嗯...
其實我做鍛造工作，
只是為了打造自己的烹飪工具。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh, I understand
that somebody needs
to fight the monsters,
but I'm the wrong person
to ask for forging weapons.
I... am a strict pacifist~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
噢，我明白有人需要去戰鬥魔物，
但找我鍛造武器就找錯人了。
我...是個堅定的和平主義者~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Just go look
around for a little
bit, I'm sure you'll
find a Blacksmith
who's willing to forge
you a good weapon~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
你到處逛逛看，
我相信你一定能找到一位
願意為你鍛造好武器的鐵匠~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Mm...?
Did you just
say that you
want to learn
the art of cooking?
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
嗯...？
你剛才說
想學烹飪
這門藝術嗎？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
I'm sorry, but I can't
really give culinary
lessons. But I will
give good advice for
hopeful beginners.
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
抱歉，我其實
不能正式教授烹飪課程。
但我可以給
有抱負的初學者
一些好的建議。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Now...
For your tuition
I'll need-- Gosh,
there's just so many
things. Get some paper,
and a pen for this list...
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
那麼...
作為學費
我需要——天哪，
東西真多。拿張紙
和筆來列個清單吧...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Just kidding!
^333333*Titter~*^000000 I don't need
much to make some
cooking utensils. Bring
6 ^0000FFLarge Jellopy^000000. That's it!
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
開玩笑的！
^333333*嘻嘻~*^000000 製作烹飪器具
不需要太多東西。帶6個
^0000FF巨大傑勒比結晶^000000 就行！

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
In return, I will give you
1 Coal and some useful
cooking advice for novices.
I give this advice for free to
my smithing colleages, though...
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
作為回報，我會給你
1個煤炭和一些
適合初學者的烹飪建議。
不過，我會免費
把這些建議給我的
鐵匠同行們...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Why ^EEA9B8don't^000000 you
become a Blacksmith?
I'm much more confident
in that field. ^333333*Tee hee~*^000000
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
你^EEA9B8為什麼^000000不
去當鐵匠呢？
我對那個領域更有信心。
^333333*嘻嘻~*^000000

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, I'll be
waiting right
here until you
come back.
...Ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
好了，我就
在這裡等著，
直到你回來。
...呵呵~

Cooking is such a joy~!

scripts.text: Um, isn't this a forge?

scripts.text: Ignore him.

you haven't been here
before, haven't you?

Cooking begins with
fire and ends with fire.
There's a certain art to
creating fine, delicious
foods to delight the palate~
scripts.translation:
[烏維]
烹飪始於火，也終於火。
要做出美味佳餚，
讓味蕾得到滿足，
其中自有其藝術~

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
What...?
Factory Repair
budget? No way!
scripts.translation:
[利奧茨堡]
什麼...？
工廠修復預算？
絕不可能！

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
Why waste money?
We haven't had any
problems so far! Look,
everything's fine! Why
are you exaggerating
such small details?
scripts.translation:
[利奧茨堡]
為什麼要浪費錢？
我們到現在為止都沒出過問題！
你看，一切都好著呢！
為什麼要誇大這些
微不足道的小事？

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
The field overseer,
Zelmeto, just came by to
ask for a budget increase.
Well, I think he's lying!
Everything's perfect!
scripts.translation:
[利奧茨堡]
現場監督澤爾梅托
剛才過來要求增加預算。
哼，我覺得他在撒謊！
一切都很完美！

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
I'm the plant
superintendant of this
factory. Most of my employees
are diligent workers. I can't say that of everyone, but overall we're doing an excellent job. Ha ha ha~!
scripts.translation:
[利奧茨堡]
我是這家工廠的廠長。
我的員工大多都很勤勉。
雖然不能說每個人都這樣，
但總體來說，我們幹得相當出色。
哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
So long as this factory
is well maintained, we won't
have to worry about this city's
safety. The field overseer,
Zelmeto, is also very reliable.
scripts.translation:
[利奧茨堡]
只要這家工廠維護得當，
我們就不必擔心這座城鎮的安全。
現場監督澤爾梅托
也是非常可靠的。

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
I can trust Zelmeto
to look after things,
so there's no need for
me to go inside the factory.
Delegating work is great!
scripts.translation:
[利奧茨堡]
我可以信任澤爾梅托
來照看這裡，
所以我不需要親自進工廠。
把工作委派給別人，
感覺真不錯！

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
Our factory will
continue to develop
and everyone will be
proud of the progress
we're making. Yes, I can
assure you of that!
scripts.translation:
[利奧茨堡]
我們的工廠將繼續發展，
每個人都會為我們取得的
進步感到自豪。
是的，我向你保證！

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
What's going on?!
Who's responsible?!
God, I can't believe
this is happening!
^333333*Cough Cough!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[利奧茨堡]
怎麼回事？！
誰該為此負責？！
天哪，我簡直不敢相信
會發生這種事！
^333333*咳咳！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
I need to get out of here!
You! D-do something and
fix this! I gotta hide and find
someplace safe!
scripts.translation:
[利奧茨堡]
我得趕緊離開這裡！
你！快...快想辦法
把它修好！
我得躲起來，找個安全的地方！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We've got a big problem
here! I appreciate that you've
been gathering the materials,
but the machines have been
broken for too long!
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我們遇到大麻煩了！
我很感激你一直在收集材料，
但是機器已經壞了太久了！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Right when I tried to
fix it, a huge shortout
occurred. Our town is
probably filled with
toxic fog right now!
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
就在我試圖修復它的時候，
發生了巨大的短路。
我們的城鎮現在
大概已經充滿了有毒的霧氣！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I'll try my best to fix
this, but we really should
have allocated some funds
to fix this machine earlier!
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我會盡力修復它的，
但我們真的應該早點
撥出資金來修復這臺機器！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
The most important
thing is that you get
out of here and find
shelter! Right now!
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
現在最重要的是，
你趕緊離開這裡，
找個地方避難！
馬上！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We'll be putting good
use to the materials you
gave me. With your help,
our factory will operate
safely. At least, for just
a little while longer.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我們會好好利用
你給我的材料。
有了你的幫助，
我們的工廠就能安全執行。
至少，還能再撐一小會兒。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Ah, it's you again.
It's shameful letting
other people know about
our miserable situation...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
啊，又是你。
讓別人知道我們
這種悽慘的處境...
真是丟人...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
There's nothing
worth seeing here,
so there really isn't
a point in you coming to
visit this place anymore.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
這裡沒什麼值得看的，
所以你也沒必要
再來這個地方了。

scripts.text: Give him materials.
scripts.translation: 給他材料

scripts.text: Huh.
scripts.translation: 哈。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
...Hm?
Aren't these the
materials we need
to make repairs in
the factory? How did
you find all of these?
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
...嗯？
這些不正是我們
維修工廠所需的材料嗎？
你是怎麼找到
這些東西的？

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I don't know how
I can possibly pay you
back for this great favor.
I appreciate that you've
stepped forward to help us.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我真不知道該如何
報答你這份大恩。
非常感謝你
挺身而出幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Oh...!
In my years of managing,
I've learned the ultimate
motivation techniques. Let
me enhance your motivation
to show you my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
哦...！
在多年的管理工作中，
我學會了終極的激勵技巧。
讓我來增強你的動力，
以表達我的謝意。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Now...
Just open your mind
and listen to my words
of encouragement
and inspiration...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
現在...
請敞開心扉，
聆聽我為你帶來的
鼓勵和靈感...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^236B8EWhen the going
gets rough, you've
gotta get rougher!
You gotta climb that
mountain 'cause no one's
gonna climb it for you!^000000
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
^236B8E當事情變得艱難時，
你必須更加頑強！
你必須去攀登那座山，
因為沒人會替你爬！^000000

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^236B8EDon't give it up!
Go for broke!
Losers are quitters
and quitters are losers!
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
^236B8E別放棄！
全力以赴！
失敗者就是放棄者，
放棄者就是失敗者！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^333333*Whew*^000000
I haven't given that much
inspriration in a while, but
your help was well worth it.
I'm going to start the repairs, but once again, I'd like to thank you.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
^333333*呼*^000000
我很久沒給過別人
這麼多靈感了，
但你的幫助非常值得。
我要開始維修了，
再次感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I'm really worried
about this factory's
future. What is our
superintendant thinking...?
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000
我真的很擔心
工廠的未來。
我們的主管在想什麼...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We need
at least
20 ^FF0000Flexible Tubes^000000,
10 ^FF0000Rusty Screw^000000 and
10 ^FF0000Used Iron Plate^000000
to repair this factory.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我們需要至少
20個^FF0000軟管^000000、
10個^FF0000生鏽的螺絲^000000和
10個^FF0000老舊的鐵板^000000
來維修這座工廠。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
But there's no way
we can get all of those
things. Our budget isn't
big enough to cover it...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000
但我們根本不可能
弄到這些東西。
我們的預算不夠支付......

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
My proposal was rejected
by our superintendant. But
maintainance and repairs
are crucial for peak operating
efficiency and worker safety!
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000
我的提議被主管否決了。
但維護和維修對於
保持最佳執行效率和
工人安全至關重要！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I'm frustrated and worried.
Maybe nothing will happen
for now, but we've got to
safeguard our future by
regularly maintaining
all of these machines.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我很沮喪也很擔心。
也許現在不會發生什麼，
但我們必須通過定期維護
所有機器來保障未來。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Even possible threats
to the safety of our workers
can't be ignored. Isn't there
something I can do? ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
即使是可能對工人安全
構成威脅的情況也不能忽視。
我能做些什麼嗎？^333333*嘆氣*^000000

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
If we can
just get
20 ^FF0000Flexible Tube^000000,
10 ^FF0000Rusty Screw^000000 and
10 ^FF0000Used Iron Plate^000000,
we could make those repairs.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
如果我們能弄到
20個^FF0000軟管^000000、
10個^FF0000生鏽的螺絲^000000和
10個^FF0000老舊的鐵板^000000，
我們就能進行維修。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
But without funds, there's
no way we can purchase
those items. If something
happens, who's going to
be responsible?
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
但沒有資金，我們根本
買不到這些東西。
如果出了事，誰該負責？

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I've got to report this
to our superintendant
as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我必須儘快向主管
彙報這件事。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
With any luck, he'll approve
a budget increase so that we
can get all of the materials
needed for the repairs.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
但願他能批准增加預算，
這樣我們就能買到
維修所需的全部材料了。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Well, I figured that both
conveyors would have
similar problems. We
can fix them at the
same time, but it'll
be a hassle.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我想這兩條傳送帶
應該都有類似的問題。
我們可以同時修復它們，
不過會很麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thank you so much for
your help. Without you,
I'm pretty sure we wouldn't
know about these problems
until it was too late.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
非常感謝你的幫助。
如果沒有你，
恐怕我們要等到
問題嚴重了才會發現。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Now, I've got to make sure
we have enough materials
to make the repairs so that
the machines will be safely
functioning again.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
現在，我得確保
我們有足夠的材料
來進行維修，
讓機器重新安全地執行。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
First, I better
hurry and request
an increase for the
Factory Repair budget
from our superintendant.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
首先，我得趕緊
向主管申請
增加工廠維修的預算。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
The machine which
you are supposed to
inspect right now
is a large conveyor.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
你現在需要檢查的機器
是一條大型傳送帶。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Remember that we
also have a small sized
conveyor, so make sure
that you examine the
larger one, alright?
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
記住，我們還有一條
小型傳送帶，
所以請確保你檢查的是
那條較大的，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
This is
worse than
I imagined...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
這比我想像的
還要糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We've got to start
repairs as soon as we
can! Hopefully, we can
resolve this before any
serious problems happen...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我們必須儘快
開始維修！
希望能在發生嚴重問題
之前解決它...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Alright, the last
thing that you need to
inspect is a ^FF0000large converyor^000000.
It's similar to the one you
inspected before, but it's
bigger and more powerful.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
好了，你需要檢查的
最後一臺機器是
一條^FF0000大型傳送帶^000000。
它和你之前檢查的那條
很像，但更大，動力也更強。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We have only one of these
machines and it's usually
moved around a lot since
a lot of people in the factory
use it. I really don't know
where it could be now.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
這種機器我們只有一臺，
而且因為工廠裡很多人
都在使用它，
它經常被移動。
我真的不知道它現在
在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Still, I'm sure that
it's inside the building,
so you should be able to
find it. I hope you can inspect
that conveyor for me soon.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
不過，我確信它
就在建築物裡面，
你應該能找到它。
希望你能儘快
幫我檢查那條傳送帶。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
This time, you need
to inspect an outdoor
pipe that is located far
outside of the factory.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
這次，你需要檢查的
是一根位於工廠
外面的室外管道。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Since there aren't any
other machines in that
area, that pipe shouldn't
be too hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
既然那個區域沒有
其他機器，
那根管道應該
不難找到。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Huh?
I'm suprised to hear
that. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 There's just
too many things that need
fixing. This is terrible...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
咦？
聽到這個我有點驚訝。
^333333*嘆氣*^000000 需要修理的東西
實在太多了。這太糟糕了...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Well, let me worry
about that for now. Please
focus on continuing to inspect
some of the other machines.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
好吧，這件事
先讓我來擔心吧。
請繼續專注於
檢查其他機器。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Now, there's a pipe inside
this factory that I want you
to look at. Many of our pipes
aren't in the best condition,
but this particular one might
be severely damaged.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
現在，工廠裡有一根
管道我想讓你看看。
我們的很多管道
狀況都不太好，
但這根可能損壞得很嚴重。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Now, the pipe I want
you to inspect is located
near those large caultrons
of molten metal. You should
be able to find it pretty easily.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我要你檢查的那根管道
位於那些大型熔爐附近。
你應該能很容易找到它。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thanks again
for your help,
adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
再次感謝你的幫助，
冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
The machine which
I want you to inspect
this time is a small
sized conveyor.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
這次我要你檢查的機器
是一條小型傳送帶。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Be sure that you
inspect the small
one, since we also
have a large conveyor
in the factory as well.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
請務必檢查小型的那臺，
因為工廠裡也有一臺
大型傳送帶。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I see...
It's most likely that
there was a short
circuit and most
of the internal devices
were burnt out...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我明白了...
很可能是短路了，
大部分內部裝置
都燒燬了...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thanks for checking
that out for me. Now,
the next machine I need
you to inspect is different
than the others I've had
you examine.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
謝謝你幫我檢查。
接下來，我需要你檢查的機器
與之前讓你檢查的那些
都不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
It's a mechanical
hand that transports
small objects. We didn't
really give it a name, but
you should be able to find it.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
那是一隻搬運小物件的
機械手。我們並沒有
給它起名字，
但你應該能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Recently, it seems
that there have been
problems in operating
that machine. If something's
broken, we need to know
and fix it right away.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
最近，那臺機器似乎
在執行上出現了問題。
如果有什麼損壞，
我們需要立刻知道並修復。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thanks again
in advance.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
再次提前
表示感謝。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I'd like you to inspect
the control panel. It's
fairly large and can be
found in the middle of the
factory. You shouldn't have
too much trouble finding it.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我想讓你檢查
控制面板。它相當大，
位於工廠的中央。
你應該不難找到它。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
What...?
This is worse
than I expected. But
it's good that we know
about these problems
as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
什麼...？
這比我預想的還要糟糕。
但能儘早發現
這些問題是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Don't you worry,
we'll take care of
this. In the meantime,
I'd like you to inspect
the next machine for me.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
別擔心，
我們會處理好的。
在此期間，
我想讓你再檢查
下一臺機器。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I want you to check
a ^FF0000control panel^000000. It's the
same kind as the one
you just inspected, but
bigger in size.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我想讓你檢查一個
^FF0000控制面板^000000。它和你剛才檢查的
是同一型別，
但尺寸更大。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
It's located in the
middle of the factory,
so you should be able
to find it. It may be in bad
condition, even though it's
operating fine for now...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
它位於工廠的中央，
所以你應該能找到它。
雖然現在執行正常，
但它的狀況可能很糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We need to ensure that
it's stable, reliable and
doesn't pose a threat to
our workforce. Thanks
again, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我們需要確保它
穩定、可靠，
並且不會對我們的
員工構成威脅。
再次感謝，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
You need to inspect
an automatic pressure
governor. It looks fine,
but sometimes it makes
strange noises.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
你需要檢查一個
自動壓力調節器。它看起來
沒問題，但有時
會發出奇怪的聲音。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
It probably will
be a good idea to
check that machine
more carefully this
time, just in case.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
這次最好
仔細檢查一下那臺機器，
以防萬一。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thank you
for helping us,
adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
謝謝你
幫助我們，
冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Huh, I see.
We must do something
about that as soon as
we can. Now, let me tell
you what to check next.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
嗯，我明白了。
我們必須儘快
處理這個問題。現在，
讓我告訴你
接下來要檢查什麼。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
There are 3 automatic
pressure governors which
hammer the bent iron plates
from above to flatten them. It
seems that one of them may
have some kind of problem.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
有3個自動壓力調節器
從上方錘擊彎曲的鐵板
使其變平。似乎其中
一個出了點問題。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Please inspect the ^FF0000automatic pressure governors^000000. Even if the
problem seems small, please
report it to me. I know it might seem fine now, but I want to prevent an accident if I can.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
請檢查^FF0000自動壓力調節器^000000。即使問題
看起來很小，也請
向我報告。我知道現在
可能看起來沒事，
但我想盡量防止事故發生。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thank you
in advance,
adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
提前
表示感謝，
冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
If you would,
please inspect the
2nd control panel that
seems to have been
broken for a while...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
如果可以的話，
請檢查那個
似乎已經損壞
了一段時間的
第2個控制面板...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Ah, you must be a visitor.
I'm Zelmeto Abellov, the
field overseer. Have you
been in this facility before?
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
啊，您一定是位訪客吧。
我是澤爾梅托·阿貝洛夫，
這裡的現場主管。
您以前來過這個設施嗎？

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
This factory plays an
important role in our city
and generates a lot of income.
However, our employees suffer
from a poor work environment.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
這家工廠在我們的城市中
扮演著重要的角色，
並帶來了大量的收入。
然而，我們的員工
卻遭受著惡劣工作環境的折磨。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Our superintendant makes a lot
of money and seems content with
the current situation. However, the rest of the workforce doesn't enjoy all of the benefits he receives...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
我們的主管賺了很多錢，
似乎對現狀很滿意。
但是，其餘的員工
卻無法享受他所得到的所有福利...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Many people have already
quit and there are only a few
people who continue to work
here. So now we're understaffed
and I'm in quite a bind...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
很多人已經辭職了，
只剩下少數人
繼續在這裡工作。
所以現在人手不足，
我陷入了相當為難的境地...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
There are some urgent
tasks I need done, but
there's no way for me
to recruit new workers.
Ah, I'm sorry, I've spoken too
freely about my own problems...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
有一些緊急的任務
需要完成，但我沒有辦法
招募新的工人。
啊，抱歉，我
太隨意地談論自己的問題了...

scripts.text: You're understaffed?
scripts.translation: 人手不足？

scripts.text: No, it's okay.
scripts.translation: 沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Yes, we are!
I don't have enough
people to inspect the
factory machines and
determine what kinds
of problems we have.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
是的，我們人手不足！
我沒有足夠的人手
去檢查工廠的機器，
並確定我們遇到了
什麼樣的問題。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
It's a time consuming
task I'd rather do on my
own. However, between that
and managing the workforce,
I don't have enough time...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
這是一項耗時的工作，
我寧願自己去做。
然而，除了這個，
我還要管理員工，
我沒有足夠的時間...

scripts.text: I can help you.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫你。

scripts.text: Keep up the good job.
scripts.translation: 繼續加油。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
You can help me?
I know something like
this is too much to ask,
but I'll accept any help
anyone offers me. I'm
that desperate.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
您能幫我嗎？
我知道這要求
可能有點過分，
但我會接受任何人
提供的幫助。我
已經走投無路了。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Alright, I'll have you
inspect the machines
in the factory one by one.
It's imperative that we know
what needs to be repaired
and what's working fine.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
好的，我會讓你
逐一檢查工廠裡的機器。
我們必須知道
哪些需要修理，
哪些執行正常。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
First, find the ^FF00002nd control
panel^000000 and determine its
status. I'm fairly certain that
it broke a long time ago, but
it wouldn't hurt to make sure.
You should find it easily.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
首先，找到^FF0000第2個控制面板^000000，
並確定它的狀態。
我相當確定它
很久以前就壞了，
但確認一下也無妨。
你應該很容易找到它。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
When you finish your
inspection, report back
to me so I can tell you
which machine to check
next. Thanks again for
offering to help.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
當您完成檢查後，
回來向我報告，
這樣我就可以告訴您
接下來要檢查哪臺機器。
再次感謝您
願意提供幫助。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Well, it's a living.
^333333*Sigh*^000000 I can put up with
this, but I hope the higher
ups will consider improving
the work environment here...
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
嗯，這就是生活。
^333333*嘆氣*^000000我可以忍受
這些，但我希望高層
能考慮改善這裡的工作環境...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thank you for
your kindness.
And please don't
let anyone know about
anything I just told you.
scripts.translation:
[澤爾梅托]
感謝您的善意。
還有，請不要讓任何人
知道我剛才告訴您的事情。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's the 2nd control panel
Zelmeto asked you to inspect.
It looks totally broken: screws
are missing, and the iron cover
has been bent open, revealing
a tangled mess of wires inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是澤爾梅托讓您檢查的第2個控制面板。
它看起來完全壞了：螺絲不見了，
鐵蓋被掰開了，露出了裡面一團亂糟糟的電線。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAt first glance, this
pressure governor looks
perfectly fine. But after you
check it more carefully, you
find that it's making strange
grinding noises and a few of
the surface screws are loose.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF乍一看，這個壓力調節器
看起來完全沒問題。但經過仔細檢查，
您發現它發出了奇怪的摩擦聲，
而且表面的一些螺絲鬆動了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe main control panel
doesn't look like it has
any problems. But after
tapping on its surface,
you hear a disheartening
hollow sound. It looks like
it's missing some parts...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF主控制面板看起來
沒有任何問題。但在敲擊它的表面後，
您聽到了令人沮喪的空洞聲。
看起來它缺少了一些部件...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe conveyor's movements
look jittery and clumsy. The
mechanical arm also doesn't
look powerful enough to bear
the loads that it's carrying. The screws in the conveyor look
loose and rusted over.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF傳送帶的運動看起來
抖動且笨拙。機械臂也看起來
力量不足以承受它正在搬運的負載。
傳送帶上的螺絲看起來
鬆動且生鏽了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe inspection of this
pipe didn't take very long.
It's bloated and worn out
from long durations of 
being overloaded with
pressure. It's a wonder
it hasn't exploded yet.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF檢查這根管道並沒有花多少時間。
它因長期承受過大的壓力而膨脹、磨損。
它竟然還沒有爆炸，真是奇蹟。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis conveyor seems
to have similar problems
as its smaller version. Its
movements are awkward,
erratic and weak, and almost
all of its screws are rusted.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這條傳送帶似乎和它的小型版本有同樣的問題。
它的動作笨拙、不穩定且無力，
而且幾乎所有的螺絲都生鏽了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Test1]
Boo~ya.
scripts.translation:
[測試1]
Boo~ya.

scripts.text:
[Test1]
Do you want
to cancel~?
scripts.translation:
[測試1]
你想取消嗎~？

scripts.text:
[Test1]
Whoa...
That is
sooo wrong!
scripts.translation:
[測試1]
哇...
這太離譜了！

scripts.text:
[Test1]
The current value
of the global variable
for the Factory Quest
is... ^3355FF{0}^000000.
You wanna change?
scripts.translation:
[測試1]
工廠任務的全域性變數當前值為...
^3355FF{0}^000000。
你想修改嗎？

scripts.text: Invade
scripts.translation: 入侵

scripts.text:
[Test1]
Okay...!
It's been
changed to ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[測試1]
好的...！
已經修改為''0。'

scripts.text:
[Test2]
Okay...!
It's been
changed to ''10.''
scripts.translation:
[測試2]
好的...！
已經修改為''10。'

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
...
......

[Buender Hikeman]
...
......
......You...

[Buender Hikeman]
...
......
......You...
......Stop it...

[Buender Hikeman]
...
......
......You...
......Stop it...
...You ^FF0000bastard^000000!

[Buender Hikeman]
RaaaaAAAARGHHH!!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
RaaaaAAAARGHHH!!

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe old man seems
slightly irked at seeing
you. Unfortunately, his
screaming and rambling
is totally incoherent.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF老人看到你似乎有些惱怒。
不幸的是，他的尖叫和胡言亂語完全語無倫次。^000000

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
It ^FF0000IS^000000 you!
You're responsible!
You've taken everything
away from me!!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
是你^FF0000沒錯^000000！
都是你的錯！
你奪走了我的一切！！

scripts.text: 'What are you talking about?'
scripts.translation: “你在說什麼？”

scripts.text: Ignore Him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
How dare you...
How dare you treat 
after destroying all the
happiness in my life!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
你竟敢...
你竟敢在我毀掉我生活中所有的幸福之後，
還這樣對我！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Damn you...
How can you have
the audacity to pretend
as if nothing happened?!
^333333*C-cough Cough...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
該死...
你怎麼敢假裝什麼都沒發生過？！
^333333*咳咳 咳咳...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
W...wait!
I said wait!
^333333*Cough!*^000000

[Buender Hikeman]
Are you so evil to
just shallowly forget
what you've done to our
lives? Did you already
forget what you did
here in Einbech?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
你竟然如此邪惡，
就這樣輕飄飄地忘記
你給我們生活帶來的災難嗎？
你已經忘了
你在這裡，在艾音貝赫做過的事了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
It was such a long
time ago, but I'll never
forget. This town was
small, but full of folk
with warm hearts...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
雖然那是很久以前的事了，
但我永遠不會忘記。
這個城鎮很小，
但這裡的人都有一顆溫暖的心...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Me, Khartophe, Anuto,
Maskharundt... All of
us were friends hired
by that big businessman
to dig up ores in the mine.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我，卡托夫，阿努托，
馬斯哈倫特...我們所有人
都是受僱於那個大商人，
在礦裡挖掘礦石的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
And then there
was you! All of us
put together made the
greatest mining team!
That was, until, we
discovered ^FF0000it^000000.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
然後就是你來了！
我們所有人加在一起，
組成了最棒的採礦隊伍！
直到...我們發現了^FF0000它^000000。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Yes...
The mysterious ore
that dazzled with a
magnificent light.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
是的...
那塊閃爍著
壯麗光芒的神秘礦石。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
But we should have known
that the ^3131FFUngoliant^000000 would
be around that ore. We
should have realized
the danger...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
但我們本該知道，
^3131FF溫古力安特^000000會在那塊礦石附近。
我們本該意識到危險的...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
We reported our findings
to our employer, and then
the ore just disappeared. He
must have sent it somewhere,
it was none of our business.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我們把發現報告給了僱主，
然後礦石就消失了。
他一定是把它運走了，
那跟我們沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Then life was back
to normal for a while.
But one day you yelled
to us that you had found
another special, mysterious
ore in the mines.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
之後生活恢復了一段時間的正常。
但有一天你衝我們大喊，
說你在礦裡又發現了一塊
特殊的、神秘的礦石。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
But when we came
over to check the hole
you dug up, you know
what we found...?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
但當我們過來檢視
你挖的那個洞時，
你知道我們發現了什麼嗎？！

scripts.text: Ungoliant?
scripts.translation: 溫古力安特？

scripts.text: A mysterious ore, right?
scripts.translation: 一塊神秘的礦石，對吧？

scripts.text: Nothing...?
scripts.translation: 什麼都沒有...？

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Don't you remember
what happened? What
you did to us at that time?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
你不記得發生了什麼嗎？
你當時對我們做了什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Don't you remember
what happened? What
you did to us at that time?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
你不記得發生了什麼嗎？
你當時對我們做了什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Yes...
Nothing.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
是的...
什麼都沒有。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
There was nothing
inside the hole!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
那個洞裡什麼都沒有！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Then you pointed to
the wall behind us and
screamed that Ungoliant
was coming! In our panic
we started to dig our way out!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
然後你指著身後的牆壁，
尖叫著說溫古力安特來了！
我們在驚慌中開始挖掘逃生！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
I remember that the expression on your face seemed so strange. I had thought you looked sad, but now I'm sure you were consumed by greed! We trusted you and you betrayed us! ^FFFFFFspace^000000
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我記得你當時的表情看起來很奇怪。我以為你是悲傷，但現在我確信你是被貪婪吞噬了！我們信任你，你卻背叛了我們！ ^FFFFFF<黑暗蒐集者>暮光^000000

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
When we finally smashed
down that last wall, everything
starting to fall around us. We
were the only two to survive
that tunnel collapse.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
當我們終於砸穿最後一堵牆時，
周圍的一切開始崩塌。
只有我們兩個人
在那次隧道坍塌中倖存了下來。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Then I learned...
You planned it all along.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
然後我明白了...
你從一開始就計劃好了這一切。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Bastard!
I'm sick of
your lies!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
混蛋！
我受夠了
你的謊言！

scripts.text: I'm not who you think!
scripts.translation: 我不是你想的那個人！

scripts.text: How did you survive the accident?
scripts.translation: 你是怎麼在那場事故中倖存下來的？

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Ha...!
Do you think
I'd so easily
forget the face
of the person who
shattered my life?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
哈...！
你以為我會輕易忘記
那個粉碎我人生的人的臉嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
When I came to,
I was lying on my
stomach in the ruins
of that dark tunnel.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
當我醒來時，
我正趴在
那條黑暗隧道的廢墟中。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
And I found...
You know what I found.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
然後我發現了...
你知道我發現了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
The corpses of my friends!
Khartophe, Anuto, Maskharundt!
Great men and my best friends.
But where were you?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
我朋友們的屍體！
卡托夫、阿努托、馬斯哈倫特！
他們是優秀的人，也是我最好的朋友。
可你在哪裡？！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Your body was nowhere
to be found. I searched
the tunnel and finally
climbed outside where
I was found unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
到處都找不到你的身影。我搜遍了隧道，
最後爬了出去，
醒來時發現自己昏迷不醒。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
I was so stupid.
It was because of
that ore! You killed our
friends and destroyed
my life for that thing!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我太愚蠢了。
都是那塊礦石的錯！你為了那個東西
殺死了我們的朋友，
毀了我的人生！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
And now...
You come out of
hiding and show up.
What do you want of
me? What more can
you possibly take away?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
而現在...
你從藏身處出來，
現身了。
你想從我這裡得到什麼？
你還想奪走什麼？！

scripts.text: I'm not who you think I am!
scripts.translation: 我不是你想的那個人！

scripts.text: I'd like to apologize.
scripts.translation: 我想向你道歉。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Quit lying!
You've stirred up
my hatred by showing
up again! I've never
forgotten that day!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
別撒謊了！
你再次出現，
激起了我的仇恨！我從未
忘記那一天！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Ha ha...
Apologize?
The harm is
already done...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
哈哈...
道歉？
傷害已經造成了...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
It's too late
for you now. For
the sake of my friends,
I'll have my vengeance!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
現在對你來說
太遲了。為了我的朋友們，
我要復仇！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Prepare to die!
^3131FFShinokas^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
準備受死吧！
^3131FF希諾卡斯^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
...!
^333333*Cough! Cough!*^000000
Noooo! N-not now...
^333333*Cough! Cough!*^000000

[{0}]
...
I better
get away
from him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...
我最好
趕緊離開他！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ran away from Hikeman
as he collapsed on the ground.
It wouldn't be a good idea to
provoke the old man anymore,
intentionally or not.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF海克曼倒在地上時，你逃走了。
無論是有意還是無意，
都不應該再激怒這位老人了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt'd be best
to avoid aggravating
the old man for now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF目前最好避免
再激怒這位老人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHikeman is dozing
off in his chair. Judging
from the look of discomfort
on his face, he seems to be
having a nightmare.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF海克曼在椅子上打瞌睡。
從他臉上痛苦的表情來看，
他似乎正在做噩夢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...

[Buender Hikeman]
Huh...?
.........!!
Hahahahaha!
Come back for
your beating,
eh, Shinokas?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
嗯...？
.........！！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
來受死吧，
希諾卡斯？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look...!
I'm not Shinokas,
okay? How can you
forget what he looks
like or how old he is?
I'm way younger!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看...！
我不是希諾卡斯，
好嗎？你怎麼會忘記
他的長相和年紀？
我年輕多了！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
What...?
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
什...麼？

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
................

[Buender Hikeman]
Uhhhh......
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
唔......

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Huh.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
嗯。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And...
I'm a cute girl!
Shinokas is male
and kind of...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且...
我是個可愛的女孩！
希諾卡斯是男性，
而且有點...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
What...?
IMPOSSIBLE!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
什...麼？
不可能！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
...
......

[Buender Hikeman]
It seems...
I've made a
huge mistake.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
看來...
我犯了一個
大錯。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Ever since the accident, people have said that I haven't been the same. Maybe they're right.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
自從那次事故以來，人們都說我不一樣了。也許他們是對的。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
I keep making the same
mistakes, so maybe they're
right about me getting senile.
Did you come just to clear
up this misunderstanding?
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我不斷犯同樣的錯誤，所以也許他們說我老糊塗了是對的。
你是來澄清這個誤會的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
Actually...
Tell Hikeman about Shinokas's death.
scripts.translation: 告訴海克曼希諾卡斯已經死了

scripts.text: Don't notify Hikeman.
scripts.translation: 不告訴海克曼

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shinokas died
a while ago in
Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希諾卡斯
不久前
在艾音布羅克去世了。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Wh-what...?
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
什...什麼...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shinokas was killed by
some men. He thinks they
may have been the ones
who hired you guys. In the
end, he was betrayed too...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希諾卡斯被
幾個男人殺死了。他認為
他們可能就是
僱傭你們的人。
最後，他也被背叛了...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
I...
I see...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我...
我明白了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shinokas may have
gotten some money,
but he spent the rest
of his life in hiding,
being hunted down.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希諾卡斯或許得到了一些錢，
但他餘生都在隱匿中度過，
被人追殺。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Nothing's left.
I've got nothing
to look foward to.
I was living only to
avenge my friends...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
什麼都沒有了。
我沒有什麼可以期待的了。
我活著只是為了
為我的朋友復仇...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Please...
Just go back to
wherever you came
from. Leave me alone...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
請...
回到你來的地方吧。
別管我了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333Did Hikeman really want
revenge on Shinokas or did
he want to hear him out since
they used to be close friends?^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333海克曼是真的想向希諾卡斯復仇，
還是因為他們是舊友，
想聽聽他的說法？^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333If I mention that
what they found was
the Ymir Heart Piece,
Hikeman might end up
getting hunted down, so
I better not say anything.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333如果我提到他們找到的是
尤米爾之心碎片，
海克曼可能會遭到追殺，
所以我最好什麼都別說。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333Why are those men
so obsessed with that
Ymir Heart Piece? Is it
really worth this kind of
cruelty? Whoever they are,
their intentions can't be good.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333那些人為什麼對那塊
伊米爾之心碎片如此執著？
它真的值得用這種殘忍的手段去奪取嗎？
不管他們是誰，他們的目的絕不會是善意的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah...
That' right.
I wanted to clear up
this misunderstanding
so you could calm down,
even if it's just a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊...
沒錯。
我想解開這個誤會，
讓你能冷靜下來，
哪怕只是一點點也好。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Well, you don't have
to worry so much about
my stress. I find that the
winds that pass through
this town to be very relaxing.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
嗯，你不必太擔心
我的壓力。我發現
穿過這座城鎮的風
非常令人放鬆。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Each time the wind
blows by, my vision blurs,
my memories haze and all
of my hatred just drifts away.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
每當風吹過，
我的視線就會模糊，
記憶變得朦朧，
所有的仇恨也隨之消散。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Without the wind, I'd only
have my hatred towards ^FF0000him^000000.
Maybe it's my only reason for
living and maybe I'm lonely,
but it's too late to feel
sorry for myself now.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
如果沒有風，
我就只剩下對^FF0000他^000000的仇恨了。
也許這是我活著的唯一理由，
也許我很孤獨，
但現在自憐已經太遲了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFHikeman is dozing
off in his chair. Judging
from the look of discomfort
on his face, he seems to be
having a nightmare.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF海克曼在椅子上打瞌睡。
從他臉上痛苦的表情來看，
他似乎正在做噩夢。

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
...!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
...！

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Awwwk~
It's killing me!
Arrrgh! Awwwrgh!
W-when will my son
come back from
the factory...?!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
啊嗚~
疼死我了！
啊！啊嗚！
我...我兒子什麼時候
能從工廠回來...？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou feel really awkward
just staring at this old
man violently rolling
around in his bed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看著這位老人在床上
劇烈地翻滾，
只是盯著他看，
我感到非常尷尬。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
...!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
...！

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Awwwk~
It's killing me!
Arrrgh! Awwwrgh!
W-when will my son
come back from
the factory...?!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
啊嗚~
疼死我了！
啊！啊嗚！
我...我兒子什麼時候
能從工廠回來...？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shi...
Shinokas?

[Sick Old Man]
Huh...?
Noooo! M-my name is
Shinotarous. Y-you've
got the wrong person!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
嗯...？
不不不！我...我叫
希諾太郎。你...你找錯人了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333This has to be the
Shinokas that Hikeman
was talking about in Einbech.
Hmmm, but how can I get
him to admit it?^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333這一定是海克曼在艾音貝赫
提到的那個希諾卡斯。
嗯，但我怎麼讓他承認呢？^000000

scripts.text: Have you ever heard of ^3131FFHikeman^000000 before?
scripts.translation: 你以前聽說過^3131FF海克曼^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Weren't you living in ^3131FFEinbech^000000?
scripts.translation: 你以前住在^3131FF艾音貝赫^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Einbech...?
No! I've never
lived there before!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
艾音貝赫...？
不！我從來沒
在那裡住過！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt doesn't seem
like this old man
is telling the truth...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這位老人似乎沒有說實話...^000000

scripts.text: Remember the mine tunnel collapse?
scripts.translation: 還記得礦洞坍塌的事嗎？

scripts.text: Didn't you used to be a miner?
scripts.translation: 你以前是礦工嗎？

scripts.text: Have you lived in Einbroch all your life?
scripts.translation: 你一直在艾音布羅克生活嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Noooo!
I don't know
what the hell
you're talking
about!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
不不不！
我完全不知道
你在說什麼！

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Nooo...!
W-why would you
even ask me that
kind of question?!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
不...！
你...你為什麼要
問這種問題？！

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Y-yes!
Born and raised
raised here in
Einbe--Einbroch!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
是...是的！
我出生並長大
在艾音...艾音布羅克！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt doesn't seem
like this old man
is telling the truth...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這位老人似乎沒有說實話...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you sure
that you don't
know anything
about ^3131FFHikeman^000000?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你確定你
對^3131FF海克曼^000000
一無所知嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
No...!
I've never met
Buender Hikeman
in my entire li--
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
不...！
我這輩子都
沒見過本德·海克曼...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
...
.......

[{0}]
I was right.
You're Shinokas!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我猜對了。
你就是希諾卡斯！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Curses!
I've blown
my cover!
W-wait! How much
do you know?!
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
該死！
我的身份暴露了！
等...等等！你知道多少？！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Did ^3131FFthey^000000 send you?
^333333*Sigh*^000000 I think that this
is it. I'll never be
able to solve the
secret before I die.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
是^3131FF他們^000000派你來的嗎？
^333333*嘆氣*^000000 我想這就是結局了。
我死前也永遠無法解開這個秘密。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Okay.
Get on with it.
I'm ready now...
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
好吧。
繼續說吧。
我現在準備好了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tell me everything
you know related to
that incident where
the mine tunnel
collapsed around
you and Hikeman.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
告訴我你知道的一切，
關於那次礦洞坍塌事故，
你和海克曼當時都在場。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
...?
Errr....
You're not
here to kill me?
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
...？
呃...
你不是來殺我的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No...!
I'm here to find
out the truth!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...！
我是來查明真相的！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
That means...
I still have some time.
This must be destiny!
Alright, I'll tell you what
happened. But it's a
long story...
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
那意味著...
我還有點時間。
這一定是命運！
好吧，我會告訴你發生了什麼。不過故事很長...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
How much do you know
about the accident? No,
wait. Don't answer that.
I don't want to hear it.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
你對那次事故瞭解多少？
不，等等。別回答。
我不想聽。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I admit it. Yes.
I stabbed my friends
in the back. It was an
unforgivable sin that will
haunt me until the day I die.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
我承認。是的。
我背叛了我的朋友。這是不可饒恕的罪孽，
將伴隨我直到死去的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I sold out my friends for
money. I destroyed that
tunnel and killed them. But
I suppose I was tricked as well. ^3131FFThey^000000 never intended to keep their end of our agreement.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
我為了錢出賣了朋友。我炸燬了隧道，殺了他們。但我想，我自己也是被騙了。^3131FF他們^000000從一開始就沒打算遵守我們的約定。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
After I destroyed the tunnel,
they targeted me and I ended
spending the rest of my life being pursued and running from place to place. What the hell was that ^3131FFore^000000 and why was it so important?
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
在我炸燬隧道之後，他們開始追殺我，我不得不度過餘生，四處逃亡。那^3131FF礦石^000000到底是什麼？為什麼它那麼重要？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I need to know more about
that ore if it's worth killing for. That's why I've risked sneaking into Einbroch. Supposedly, an ore similar to the one we found has
been transported here recently.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
如果那種礦石值得為此殺人，我就必須瞭解更多。這就是我冒險潛入艾音布羅克的原因。據說最近有一種與我們發現的那塊相似的礦石被運到了這裡。

scripts.text: Did you find it?
scripts.translation: 你找到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
No, not yet.
I've been searching
for that ore every night.
During the day, this kind
blacksmith has managed
to hide me from those men.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
還沒有。
我每天晚上都在尋找那種礦石。
白天，這位鐵匠幫我藏起來，躲避那些人的追捕。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
But I won't be safe
for very long. Look, I'm
no saint, but before I die,
I wanna do this one last
thing and see what's so
great about this ore...
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
但我不會安全太久。聽著，我雖然不是聖人，但在死之前，我想做最後一件事，看看這種礦石到底有什麼特別之處...

scripts.text: Wait, who's trying to get you?
scripts.translation: 等等，是誰在追殺你？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Who's trying to kill me?
The people who hired me and
my friends to dig up that ore in the first place. We thought they were ordinary businessmen,
but... They're dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
誰想殺我？
就是當初僱傭我和朋友去挖那塊礦石的人。我們以為他們是普通的商人，但...他們很危險。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
So I told you everything
and now you know that my
days might be numbered.
Please do an old man a favor
and search Einbroch for that
strange, mysterious ore.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
所以我什麼都告訴你了，現在你也知道我的日子可能不多了。
請幫一個老人個忙，去艾音布羅克找找那種神秘莫測的礦石。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Now, the first thing I learned
in this town is that the richest family is the Kapellthaines. Only the rich and powerful can possibly be involved in something so big.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
首先，我在這個城鎮瞭解到，最富有的家族是卡佩爾泰因家。只有富人和權貴才可能捲入這麼大的事情。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Would you search
Kappellthaine Manor
for that ore? It's on the way
to the Airport and it shouldn't be hard to miss. They're the richest people in Einbroch, after all.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
你能去卡佩爾泰因莊園找找那種礦石嗎？它在去機場的路上，應該很容易找到。畢竟，他們是艾音布羅克最富有的人。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I'm too old and weak to leave
this house, and there's the chance that those men will find me. If you can sympathize with my situation, please find out if the Kapellthaine family has any unique ores...
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
我年紀大了，身體虛弱，無法離開這棟房子，而且那些隨時可能找到我。如果你能體諒我的處境，請查一下卡佩爾泰因家族是否藏有什麼特殊的礦石...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Please...
Find out if the Kapellthaines
are keeping some kind of unique
ore. Their manor is on the road
that leads to the Airport.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
拜託了...
查一下卡佩爾泰因家族是否藏有某種特殊的礦石。他們的莊園就在通往機場的路上。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
So, did you find
anything from the
Kapellthaines?
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
那麼，你在卡佩爾泰因家找到什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, Mr. Kapellthaine
is kind of violent, but
I didn't find anything
really suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，卡佩爾泰因先生有點暴力，但我沒發現什麼特別可疑的東西。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Huh...
I must have
been wrong, then...
Where else could it be?
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
哈...
看來是我搞錯了...
那它還能在哪裡呢？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Oh, right! The huge
factory in Einbroch!
What could be more
suspicious? There's a ton
of workers, but no one really
knows what they do there...
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
對了！艾音布羅克那座巨大的工廠！
還有什麼比那更可疑的嗎？那裡有很多工人，但沒人知道他們在那裡做什麼...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
If they're so secretive,
it's possible that they're
keeping the ore over there.
Please go and search the
Factory for that ore as
soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
如果他們這麼神秘，有可能就是把礦石藏在那裡了。
請儘快去工廠找找那種礦石。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
So...?
Did you learn
anything new
in the Factory?
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
那麼...？
你在工廠裡
有什麼新發現嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...
There's a lot of
suspicious business
in the factory, but I don't
think any of it is related
to that ore you mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
工廠裡有很多可疑的勾當，但我覺得沒有一件和你提到的那種礦石有關。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Damn it...
Then where did
they hide it? Where
do you think that
ore might be?
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
該死...
那他們到底把它藏在哪裡了？
你覺得那種礦石可能在哪裡？

scripts.text: Airport
scripts.translation: 機場

scripts.text: Factory
scripts.translation: 工廠

scripts.text: Train Station
scripts.translation: 火車站

scripts.text: Airship Repairshop
scripts.translation: 飛空艇維修店

scripts.text: Laboratory
scripts.translation: 實驗室

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
No...
The Airport is always
crowded with people.
It'd be a bad idea to hide
something so important
in that kind of place.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
不...
機場總是人山人海。
把那麼重要的東西藏在
那種地方，絕對是個壞主意。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Didn't you just
check the factory?
You couldn't find
any clues to the
ore over there...
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
你剛才不是
剛去工廠查過了嗎？
你在那邊
沒有找到任何
關於礦石的線索...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Hmm...
People are always going
in and out of the Train Station. It's not the best place to hide something as important as the ore.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
嗯...
火車站總是進進出出的人很多。
把礦石這麼重要的東西藏在那裡，
並不是最好的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
The Airship? Hm, it does
fly through some mysterious
power... But I already checked
the Airship Repairshop myself.
I haven't found any trace of
the ore over there.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
飛空艇？嗯，它確實
靠某種神秘的力量飛行...
但我已經親自去
飛空艇維修店查過了。
我沒有在那裡
找到任何礦石的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
...!
Yes. Yes...!
That could be it!
Why didn't I think
about the Laboratory?
It makes so much sense!
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
...！
是的。是的...！
可能就是那裡！
我為什麼沒想到
實驗室呢？
這太合理了！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I have a good feeling
about this. Please sneak
into that Laboratory and
see if you can find the ore!
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
我對這件事
很有預感。請潛入
那個實驗室，
看看能不能找到礦石！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Remember...
Not just anybody
can enter that kind
of place. But I'm sure
you'll figure something out.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
記住...
不是誰都能
進入那種地方的。但我相信
你一定能想出辦法的。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I'm really in no position
to ask and I'm not trying
to give you a hard time on
purpose, but would you please
check for any traces of the ore
in the Factory once again?
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
我其實
沒有立場要求你，
我也不是故意
要為難你，但你能不能
再去工廠查一次
礦石的痕跡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shinokas,
I found something!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希諾卡斯，
我發現了什麼！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
You...
Came... back...
Even... if... it's
already... Too late.
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000

^3355FFYou help Shinokas
sit up, but find that
your hands have been
stained with his blood.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你扶希諾卡斯
坐起來，卻發現
自己的手
沾滿了他的血。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Blood...?!
Shinokas!
Who did this to you?
W-we need to call for help!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
血...？！
希諾卡斯！
是誰對你做的？
我...我們需要叫人來幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
No...
It's already
too late for me.
I should have died
a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
不...
對我來說
已經太晚了。
我其實
早就該死了...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
^333333*Cough*^000000
I only regret that
I've never been able
to apologize to my
friends... ^333333*Cough!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
^333333*咳嗽*^000000
我唯一的遺憾是
我從來沒有
向我的朋友們
道過歉... ^333333*咳嗽！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
But did you
find out? D-did
you find out what's
so special about
that ore? W-what
is it... Really?
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
但是，你
查清楚了嗎？你...你
查清楚那種礦石
有什麼特別之處了嗎？它...它
到底是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Y-Ymir...?
The h-heart of Ymir?
The power to control
the world... We really
did find something
great, didn't we?
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
伊...伊米爾...？
伊...伊米爾的心臟？
控制世界的力量...我們
真的找到了
不得了的東西，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I remember...
The first time
we saw it. We...
We were so excited.
So amazed and proud...
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
我記得...
第一次看到它的時候。
我們...
我們太興奮了。
太驚訝，太自豪了...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
But digging up...
Something so great...
Was only possible
with-- ^333333*Cough*^000000 --
M-my buddies...
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
但是挖掘...
如此偉大的東西...
只有靠-- ^333333*咳嗽*^000000 --
我...我的夥伴們...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
^333333*Cough*^000000
It's getting...
Darker... I...
Don't have to
run anymore.
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
^333333*咳嗽*^000000
周圍變得...
越來越暗了... 我...
不用再逃了。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
W-wait...!
What did...
I can't underst--
^333333*Cough cough!*^000000

[{0}]
No...!
Tell me who
did this to you!
Where are they?
Speak to me, please!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...!
告訴我，是誰
對你做了這種事！
他們在哪裡？
請跟我對話！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
W-wha...?
I told you.
Th-they we--
scripts.translation:
[希諾卡斯]
什...什麼...？
我告訴過你。
他...他們曾--

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
...
......

[{0}]
No!
Shinokas!
Why, God?
Why...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不！
希諾卡斯！
為什麼，神啊？
為什麼...

scripts.text:
^3355FFShinokas's
body has grown
cold to the touch.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF希諾卡斯
的身體已經冰冷了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
...
......

[Maid]
Did you ask me
if I saw some kind
of ore around here?
That's strange...
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
你問我
有沒有看到
附近的礦石？
真奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Well, I've been with
this family for a long
time. Let me assure you
that there's no secrets
from me in this household!
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
嗯，我在這個
家族工作很久了。
請放心，
這個家裡沒有任何
對我保密的秘密！

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I'm sorry, but I don't
think we have any ores,
special or otherwise, here
in the manor. What exactly
do you need them for?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
抱歉，我想我們
這裡沒有礦石，
無論是特別的還是普通的。
你具體需要它們做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
There's no end
to all these plates
I have to clean...!
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
這些碟仙惡靈
沒完沒了地
需要我清理...!

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
^333333*Grumble grumble*^000000

[Scientist]
Huh...?
How did you
get in here?
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
嗯...？
你是怎麼
進來的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Ah....
I'm the new...
Guard. Nice
to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！啊....
我是新來的...
衛兵。很高興
見到你。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Oh. Yeah.
Nice-meet-you.
..............
^333333*Grumble grumble*^000000
What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text: Catch you later.
scripts.translation: 回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
What's wrong...?!
Oh, don't get me started!
I'm stuck here doing all the
work while the Lab Department Head goes out every freakin' day!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
怎麼了...？!
哦，別提了！
我留在這裡做所有的工作，
而實驗室主任每天都出去鬼混！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
While I'm slaving
away here, he's in
that Airship, busy
flirting with that
woman. God...!
I'm like, so teed off!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
我在這兒拼命幹活，
他卻在那艘飛空艇上，
忙著和那個女人調情。天哪...!
我真是氣炸了！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Right.
Yeah.
Later, man.
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
好的。
嗯。
回頭見，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Man alive!
Would it kill the
Department Head
to come in here and do
some work for a change?!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
天哪！
難道主任就不能
偶爾來這兒
乾點活兒嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
I mean, come on!
I shouldn't have to
carry his workload!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
我是說，拜託了！
我不應該
替他承擔工作量！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something
attached to a huge
machine with many cords
and folds of barbed wire.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有一樣東西
附著在一臺巨大的機器上，
上面有許多電線
和帶刺的鐵絲網。^000000

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Soldier]
This area
is off limits.
Please leave
immediately.
scripts.translation:
[實驗室士兵]
此區域
禁止入內。
請立刻離開。

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Soldier]
Yuck...!
There's this
nasty dusty taste
right inside my mouth
that I can't get rid of!
scripts.translation:
[實驗室士兵]
噁心...！
我嘴裡
有一股難聞的灰塵味，
怎麼都去不掉！

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Soldier]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I want to go home.
Get some mouthwash.
You know. Something.
scripts.translation:
[實驗室士兵]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000
我想回家。
去買點漱口水。
你知道的，隨便什麼。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Okay okay...
Daddy's gonna
win some Apples
this time for sure!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
好好好...
爸爸這次
肯定能贏到蘋果！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Let's do it!
^3131FFYmir's Heart^000000 is
on my side! GO!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
來吧！
^3131FF伊米爾之心^000000
站在我這邊！衝啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
What did he just say?
It seemed important!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
他剛才說什麼？
聽起來很重要！

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[Kaci]
I have a total of ^FF000011^000000
and you have total ^FF00005^000000.
You lose this game. I'm
sorry, but I hope we play
again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[凱西]
我的總分是 ^FF000011^000000，
你的總分是 ^FF00005^000000。
你輸掉了這局。
很抱歉，希望下次
還能再玩。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Waaaaaahhhhhhhhh!
Apples! My apples!
Apples, I need more...!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
哇啊啊啊啊啊！
蘋果！我的蘋果！
蘋果，我需要更多...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want
some of mine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要不要
分我一些？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
What...?
I can't do anything
with so few Apples!
I'm a high roller and
this is a high stakes game!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
什...？
只有這麼點蘋果
我什麼都做不了！
我是個大賭徒，
這是場高風險的遊戲！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want
some of mine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要不要
分我一些？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Wha--? Yes...
Hell yes! Gimme
some of your Apples!
Yeeeeeeeeeeehaw!
I'm back, baby!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
什...？是的...
當然！快把你的蘋果
給我一些！
耶嘿嘿嘿嘿！
我回來了，寶貝！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Now, to win!
Daddy needs love...
Time to go from
crappy to classy!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
現在，去贏吧！
爸爸需要愛...
是時候從
糟糕變得優雅了！

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[Kaci]
I got a total of ^FF00008^000000,
and you have total ^FF000011^000000.
Congratulations, you won!
Let me give you your winnings
and we'll play again some time~
scripts.translation:
[凱西]
我的總分是 ^FF00008^000000，
你的總分是 ^FF000011^000000。
恭喜你，你贏了！
讓我把獎金給你，
我們改天再玩~

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Oooh...
I got a total of ^FF000010^000000,
and you have a total of ^FF00007^000000.
I'm sorry, but you lose
again. Better luck next time...
scripts.translation:
[凱西]
噢...
我的總分是 ^FF000010^000000，
你的總分是 ^FF00007^000000。
很抱歉，你又輸了。
下次好運...

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Waaaaahhhhhhhhhh!
Waaaaaaahhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
哇啊啊啊啊啊！
哇啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Mwahhahahahaha!
Whahahahahahahaha!
That's why they call me
the ''Resurrection Kid!''
I always come back!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
這就是為什麼他們叫我
“復活小孩”！
我總是能回來！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Oh yes, right!
You...! You lent
me those lucky
Apples. ^333333*Hiccup*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
啊對對對！
你...！你借給我的
那些幸運蘋果。
^333333*打嗝*^000000

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
I'm Kurshenburg!
Thanks to you, I'm
on a winning streak!
Hahaha! Th-thank you~
^333333*Hic-hic-hiccup!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
我是庫爾森伯格！
多虧了你，我
現在連勝中！
哈哈哈！謝...謝謝你~
^333333*嗝-嗝-嗝*^000000

scripts.text: So what was that about Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation: 那關於尤彌爾之心是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: Hehe, you're welcome.
scripts.translation: 呵呵，不客氣。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
What...?
Ymir's Heart?
How do you know
about that? ^333333*Hiccup*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
什...麼？
尤彌爾之心？
你怎麼會知道
那個東西？
^333333*打嗝*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Y-you...!
You were just yelling,
''Ymir's Heart is on my
side,'' while you were
gambling with those Apples!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你剛才
在拿那些蘋果賭博的時候，
一直在大喊
“尤彌爾之心在我這邊”！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
What...?!
No way~
Err...? Did I...?
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
什...麼？！
不會吧~
呃...？難道我...？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Heh heh...
I'm not really
supposed to be talking
about this. As head of
the Laboratory, I'm sworn
to secrecy about Ymir's Heart.
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
嘿嘿...
其實我不太應該
談論這個。作為實驗室的負責人，
我對尤彌爾之心負有保密義務。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
But what do I care?!
All they want are the
results of my research!
They don't appreciate
my work at all! My title
is completely worthless!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
但我管他們幹什麼！
他們只想要我的研究成果！
他們根本不尊重我的工作！
我的頭銜完全一文不值！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
You don't know how long I've
been imprisoned in the lab and
that the work conditions just get worse and worse. Screw them! I'll keep getting paid as long as I show them some progress in our project!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
你不知道我被關在實驗室裡多久了，
而且工作條件越來越差。
去他們的吧！只要我向他們展示專案有進展，他們就會一直付我薪水！

scripts.text: Project?
scripts.translation: 專案？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Yeah, we're researching
Ymir's Heart. It was found
a long time ago in ^3131FFEinbech^000000
and it's in our lab now.
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
是的，我們正在研究
尤彌爾之心。它很久以前在
^3131FF艾音貝赫^000000被發現的，
現在就在我們的實驗室裡。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Everyone knows it's supposed
to hold some legendary power,
but even I was surprised to see
what it was capable of. It's both terrible and miraculous, scary
and wondrous...
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
大家都知道它應該蘊含著某種傳奇的力量，
但連我都驚訝於它的能力。
它既可怕又神奇，既恐怖又美妙...

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
So...
I figure...
It may even
have the power to
win me Dice games!
Bwahaha--^333333*Hiccup!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
所以...
我想...
它甚至可能擁有
讓我在骰子游戲中獲勝的力量！
哇哈哈--^333333*打嗝！*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(That thing I saw
hooked up to all those
wires in the Laboratory
must have been a piece
of ^3131FFYmir's Heart^333333. I better
tell Shinokas about this.)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333(我在實驗室裡看到的那個
連線著所有電線的那個東西，
一定是^3131FF尤彌爾之心^333333的一部分。
我最好告訴希諾卡斯這件事。) ^000000

scripts.text:

Hahahaha!
You're great!
And I feel great!
Everything's great!
Bwahahahaahahah!
^333333*Hiccup*^000000
scripts.translation:

你太棒了！
